research_question: Can a recomputed versioned workflow-validity graph with dependency-scoped invalidation and a minimal valid-action frontier recover from changing procurement state while using LLM deliberation only where multiple valid choices remain?
central_hypothesis: Long-horizon failures are caused less by missing history than by failure to distinguish still-valid decisions from decisions invalidated by new evidence. Recomputing validity from visible facts and exposing only the current repair/decision frontier should prevent stale actions and clarification loops while preserving flexible LLM choice at genuine decision points.

inherited_baseline.name: coverage_repair_v0.1
inherited_baseline.reason: Coverage+Repair already earned the strongest development quality/cost region. The proposed controller must isolate incremental value from validity/invalidation rather than rediscover supplier coverage.

controller.name: State Validity Frontier
controller.implementation_requirement: Recompute the structured validity graph from current visible factual state/action history each step. Do not maintain a free-text plan or free-text persistent ledger.

requirement_epoch.purpose: Version solicitation/offer/evaluation validity after externally visible requirement changes.

clarification_lease.rule: After one accepted request_buyer_clarification in an epoch, clarification is removed from the frontier until a new requirement epoch. A buyer_clarification observation resolves the current clarification opportunity; absence of a response does not permit immediate repeated clarification.

action_selection.singleton_frontier: execute deterministically without a model call
action_selection.multiple_valid_actions: one LLM call chooses only among frontier actions using factual_compiled_v0.1
action_selection.terminal_actions: allowed only when evaluation validity is current
action_selection.optional_recovery_evidence: After supplier withdrawal or other evaluation invalidation, request_quote_revision on an active supplier may coexist with evaluate_quotes in the frontier; the LLM decides whether additional evidence acquisition is worth taking.

safety_invariants: withdrawn supplier can never be awarded
terminal decision cannot depend on an invalid evaluation
evaluation cannot be treated as current after a visible quote/revision/withdrawal/requirement-version change
an offer from an earlier requirement epoch is stale until refreshed
request_buyer_clarification cannot repeat within one requirement epoch
controller never creates facts that were not visible

assertions: issue_amendment becomes required after the visible change because sourcing already started

no clarification loop occurs in the unchanged requirement epoch

heldout_policy.prior_heldout_021_030: diagnostic_only_for_new_method; already inspected and cannot be used as untouched test evidence
heldout_policy.future_test_set: After the method and development protocol are frozen, author and validate a new untouched 031+ held-out set before any model-backed call.
heldout_policy.contamination_rule: No result from 021-030 or the future held-out set may update method rules or prompts.

related_work_boundary.stateflow: Generic state-machine orchestration is not a novelty claim.
related_work_boundary.planfence: Dependency-scoped validity checking/replanning is not a novelty claim.
related_work_boundary.contribution_condition: Any eventual method claim must be narrower and empirically isolated: recomputed versioned procurement-workflow validity + minimal repair frontier + selective model allocation, with ablations showing which component produces quality/cost gains.

claim_policy.before_results: Do not call this a successful ProcureHarness architecture or claim superiority/novelty.
claim_policy.after_targeted_pass: Only claim that the mechanism activated and passed the frozen targeted gate.
claim_policy.paper_level: Requires repeated development comparison, ablations, and a new untouched held-out set.
